title: Open Speculative Model Configuration
description: Schema for a speculative decoding dflash draft model configuration with a Qwen3 transformer architecture.

open_spec_config_version.description: Version of the open speculative-model configuration format.

architectures.description: Model implementation classes that can load this configuration.

auto_map.description: Mapping from auto-model class names to custom implementation import paths.

speculative_config.description: Configuration for speculative token generation and verification.

method.description: Speculative decoding algorithm identifier, such as dflash or dspark.

speculative_tokens.description: Number of speculative tokens generated per decoding turn.

verifier.description: Optional model identifier for the verifier model.

target_layer_ids.description: Verifier hidden-state layer indices consumed by the draft model.

target_layer_start_idx.description: Index of the first target layer used by the draft model. 0 or 1.

draft_vocab_size.description: Optional size of the reduced vocabulary used by the draft model.

sample_from_anchor.description: Whether token sampling may start from the anchor token.

sliding_window_non_causal.description: Whether draft sliding-window attention may attend non-causally within its window.

mask_token_id.description: Vocabulary ID of the mask token used during draft generation.

speculative_library.description: Library used to train or implement the speculative model.

attention_bias.description: Whether self-attention projection layers use bias parameters.

attention_dropout.description: Dropout probability applied to attention probabilities.

bos_token_id.description: Beginning-of-sequence token ID, or null when one is not configured.

eos_token_id.description: End-of-sequence token ID or IDs, or null when none are configured.

hidden_act.description: Activation function used by the feed-forward network.

hidden_size.description: Width of the transformer hidden representations.

initializer_range.description: Standard deviation used when initializing model weights.

intermediate_size.description: Width of the feed-forward network's intermediate representation.

layer_types.description: Attention implementation for each draft transformer layer.

items.description: The attention implementation used by one layer.

max_position_embeddings.description: Maximum sequence length represented by the model's positional encoding.

max_window_layers.description: Number of initial layers using full attention before sliding-window attention begins.

num_attention_heads.description: Number of query attention heads per transformer layer.

num_hidden_layers.description: Number of transformer layers in the draft model.

num_key_value_heads.description: Number of key/value heads used for grouped-query attention.

pad_token_id.description: Padding token ID, or null when one is not configured.

rms_norm_eps.description: Epsilon used by RMS normalization layers.

rope_theta.description: Base period used by rotary positional embeddings.

sliding_window.description: Sliding-attention window size, or null when sliding-window attention is disabled.

tie_word_embeddings.description: Whether input and output token embedding weights are shared.

transformers_version.description: Transformers library version used to serialize the configuration.

use_cache.description: Whether the model returns and consumes key/value caches during autoregressive decoding.

vocab_size.description: Size of the model tokenizer vocabulary.
